policy: OpenRouter first: free models, then medium-cost. If an OpenRouter model costs less than Claude and did as well or better in the project probes, it does the work and Claude checks. Nothing above the price cap: Opus runs only the main session.
evidence: 2026-09-15. Probe 1: generic bug finding, JSON extraction, constrained summary (22 models). Probes 2-3: project tasks (museum prose from the published Manikapatna entry scored with text-readability, verbatim claim extraction, Lighthouse summary with Kaspersky artefacts) against Claude Sonnet 5 and Haiku 4.5 baselines; probe 3 with reasoning off. One run per model per task: a filter, not a benchmark. Every candidate passed data_collection=deny and the price cap.

draft_prose.use_for: First draft of museum copy (src/content) from a sourced data entry. The editor agent checks every sentence and citation.
draft_prose.notes: Probe 3: Qwen3.8 Flash scored 7/7 (grade 6.0) against Claude Sonnet 5's 6/7, at about 1/25 of the cost; Dots-3 (free) scored 6/7. Every model, Sonnet included, misattributed at least one citation, so match each claim to the source_refs note that contains it. Ask for 70-100 words and one citation per paragraph, and cut embellishments that no source supports.

extract_claims.use_for: Pulling candidate claims with verbatim quotes out of long source excerpts, OCR text or research notes, for the researcher to verify and tier.
extract_claims.notes: With reasoning off, all four returned exact quotes, covered every fact and marked the speculative claim as speculative (6/6). Sonnet scored 4-5 because it altered a quote. Check each quote is an exact substring of the source (a one-line script is enough). Excluded here: North Mini Code and GPT-5.6 Luna, which presented speculation as fact.

audit_summary.use_for: Turning Lighthouse output, extracted audit fields or long reports into a blocking-issues list for the qa-auditor.
audit_summary.notes: Qwen3.8 Flash scored 6/6 in both runs. Ling (free) scored 6 then 5, the same as Claude Haiku (the auditor's own model): both called localhost HTTPS a site bug. Always state in the prompt that gc.kis.v2.scr.kaspersky-labs.com requests and is-on-https on localhost are environment artefacts. Check every number against the report JSON.

code_review.use_for: First-pass review of large files or diffs for bugs, edge cases and security issues. Claude verifies every finding.
code_review.notes: North Mini Code was concise and complete on code in probe 1, but it has invented findings before, so verify each one. Kimi K2.7 Code cannot turn reasoning off; the server retries it at low effort. Use Kimi when the cheaper reviews look shallow.

summarise_extract.use_for: Summarising or extracting structured data from long files, logs, reports or JSON, returning short output.
summarise_extract.notes: Dots-3 has 512K context but is wordy, so ask for bullets or JSON. GLM-5.3 Flash cannot turn reasoning off (the server retries at low effort), so give it max_tokens of 2000 or more.

draft_code.use_for: Drafting boilerplate, tests, scripts, regexes, small components or SVG templates that Claude then checks with check/build/tests.
draft_code.notes: GPT-5.6 Luna was fast and terse and leads cheap models on public coding comparisons. Qwen3 Coder Next is fastest but missed a bug in the review probe, so use it for drafting, not review.

debug_second_opinion.use_for: A bug Claude is stuck on after one real attempt: root-cause hypotheses from a different model family.
debug_second_opinion.notes: The one task where reasoning is worth paying for. Include the error, the relevant files via file_paths, and what Claude has already ruled out.

compare_perspectives.use_for: Design trade-offs or ambiguous questions where disagreement between model families is itself useful.
compare_perspectives.notes: Pass either the two free models or the three medium ones (three vendors). Claude synthesises and decides.

quick_question.use_for: Short technical questions (API usage, library behaviour, an error message) that need no repo context.
quick_question.notes: Check answers against the docs or the code.

keep_on_claude: Main session only (Opus): planning, delegation, final decisions, verification
Fact-checking and choosing sources, tiers, ids and coordinates (agents on Sonnet)
Architecture and multi-file integration (engineer on Sonnet)
Tiny tasks, where a handoff costs more than it saves
Anything that would need a model above the price cap
